Theorem/lemma selection requires a named theorem with := body; the extractor rejects wrong kinds, duplicate/unsupported declarations and indented sibling commands. Rendering retains the exact selected statement/proof and forbids nested proof/definition/example blocks. Tests cover literal qualified names, comments/string decoys, complete proof output and every nested block-kind combination. Lean proof correctness remains a separate check. This unit introduces its own objects and notation; it has no explicit :uses: prerequisites.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent fresh reviewer.

Lean checks proof correctness separately. Tooling review checks implementation and finite test coverage, not universal correctness or browser/CDN behavior. Additional context keys identify supporting definitions inspected in those files, not an audit of every proof or line.
